# Paper figure attribution

These third-party figures are not covered by the repository's MIT code license.

- `textile-science-advances-2020.jpg`: Fan et al., “Machine-knitted washable sensor array textile for precise epidermal physiological signal monitoring,” Science Advances 6, eaay2840 (2020), Figure 1. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aay2840 . Photo credit: Wenjing Fan, Chongqing University. CC BY-NC 4.0. Unmodified. Source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7069695/ .
- `gwnet-figure-1.jpg`: Chen et al., “Gate-based GWNet for process quality filter and multioutput prediction,” Expert Systems with Applications 264, 125921 (2025), Figure 1. Shown in the first author's research portfolio. Original publisher terms apply. Source: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S095741742402788X .

- `accessible-figure-1.png`: Chen et al., “Towards Accessible AI Research for Complex Batch Biochemical Processes,” IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement (2026). First figure supplied by the first author as `model_update.pdf`, rendered without changing its content. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1109/TIM.2026.3655901 . Original figure rights apply.
- `ode-figure-1.jpg`: Chen et al., “Pushing limits in ODE-aware step-coupled learning for biopharmaceutical forecasting,” Information Fusion, 104996, Figure 1. Unmodified publisher image: https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S1566253526008729-gr1_lrg.jpg . DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.inffus.2026.104996 . Original publisher terms apply.
- `safeguard-figure-1.png`: Chen et al., “Bio-Process Safeguard: Leveraging Multi-Agent Kinetic Identification and Dynamic Thresholding for Biopharmaceutical ICS Security,” ICPADS (2026), Figure 1, “Biodynamic Agents. Architecture.” Extracted from page 68 of the first author's supplied proceedings PDF; surrounding paper text excluded, figure content unchanged. Project: https://github.com/cynara517/Fermentation-CPS-Security-ESORICS2026 . Original figure rights apply.
